en.topic_title: Rescuers dig into tunnel as missing toll from Nepal, China flood tops 3,000
en.topic_summary:
Rescuers in Nepal and China battled Sunday through leg-sucking mud and the threat of rising rivers and a newly formed lake to search for thousands missing after a deadly wall of water and debris swept through the Himalayas, engulfing entire villages.



A team of Nepal police and National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA) retrieves money and documents from a bank covered in sludge in the aftermath of flash floods at Trishuli in Nepal’s Nuwakot district on August 30,
